rules.sessionRequirement: Run every trial in a fresh client session without naming RawTrace, MCP, or the bundled skill in the prompt.

cases.prompt: A Playwright test clicks Save, but roughly one run in ten produces no request, no toast, and no navigation; an immediate retry passes. Diagnose the cause in the authorized local test environment and collect evidence for the missing transition.
cases.expectedWorkflow: Use capture_targets and capture_start with the authorized CDP endpoint, reproduce through the external controller, capture_stop, then trace_info and targeted trace_events/trace_state. Check completeness and gaps.

cases.prompt: A Cypress test hovers a menu and then clicks a submenu item. The submenu sometimes appears for only a fraction of a second and disappears before the click. Reproduce the timing failure in the authorized staging environment and explain the DOM sequence.
cases.expectedWorkflow: Use capture_targets and capture_start with the authorized CDP endpoint, reproduce through the external controller, capture_stop, then trace_info and targeted trace_events/trace_state. Check completeness and gaps.

cases.prompt: Our browser chat test intermittently receives the first WebSocket message before the UI has processed the subscription acknowledgement, leaving the message list empty. Diagnose the ordering issue in the local test app.
cases.expectedWorkflow: Use capture_targets and capture_start with the authorized CDP endpoint, reproduce through the external controller, capture_stop, then trace_info and targeted trace_events/trace_state. Check completeness and gaps.
